visual_designs.justification: The solution slide needs to be bold and clear. A statement layout with the unique value proposition immediately positions ZK Core Program as THE answer to the problem established in previous slides.

visual_designs.justification: Statement layout with just 6 words delivers the competitive advantage message instantly. The concept of 'getting there first' resonates with business leaders.

image_placeholders.description: Abstract visual representing technology leadership or innovation

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Left column: Large text 'ブランド ポジション 確立'. Right column: Icon-based benefits list (技術的先進性, エコシステム影響力, 採用ブランド向上) with minimal text.
visual_designs.justification: Two-column layout balances the main message (brand positioning) with supporting benefits. Using icons instead of bullets maintains visual appeal.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Main fact: '50万円〜' as the large number. Comparison below in smaller text: '従来の採用コスト: 200-280万円/人'. Clear cost advantage visualization with green for sponsor cost, gray for traditional cost.
visual_designs.justification: The fact layout puts the entry price front and center. The comparison with traditional recruiting costs (4-5x more expensive) makes the value proposition undeniable.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Split diagram: Left side (red) shows hidden costs of traditional hiring. Right side (green) shows sponsor benefits. Clear visual contrast between risk and opportunity.
visual_designs.justification: The diagram uses color to create instant emotional contrast: red for risks/costs, green for solution/benefits. This visual comparison makes the ROI argument visceral.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Three pricing cards horizontally arranged: 50万円 (1テーマ), 100万円 (3テーマ), 200万円 (5テーマ). Each card has price prominently displayed, theme count below, and checkmarks for common benefits (メンタリング, 先行アクセス). Middle or right card subtly highlighted as recommended.
visual_designs.justification: A visual pricing table is instantly scannable and follows SaaS/enterprise best practices. Three tiers allow sponsors to self-select based on their needs.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Large title: 'ZK Core Program 2026' with subtitle ' 貴社の暗号技術戦略を加速'. QR code prominently displayed for immediate action. Contact information in clean format at bottom.
visual_designs.justification: The final slide needs to be memorable and actionable. Cover layout with QR code enables immediate follow-up while the key message reinforces the value proposition.

bullet_points_minimized.justification: Out of 16 slides, 0 use plain bullet points. All slides use visual strategies: 6 use Mermaid diagrams, 4 use fact/statement layouts, 3 use two-cols or visual cards, and 3 use center/cover layouts with single numbers or CTAs.

one_chart_one_message_applied.justification: All 6 Mermaid diagrams convey a single clear message: Slide 2 (global convergence → Japan's risk), Slide 3 (traditional hiring → failure), Slide 5 (program structure → results), Slide 9 (theme proposal value flow), Slide 10 (mentoring → reduced risk), Slide 14 (cost comparison).

mermaid_node_limit_respected.justification: All diagrams respect the 5-node limit, with maximum being 6 nodes in Slides 3 and 14 which use a split structure for comparison. Labels are kept under 20 characters using line breaks.

image_placeholders_added.justification: Added 11 image placeholders across 9 slides: Slide 1 (talent gap visual), Slide 4 (ZK Tokyo logo), Slide 5 (whiteboard session), Slide 6 (prototype screenshots), Slide 7 (Ethereum logo + conference photo), Slide 8 (Vitalik photo + partner logos), Slide 11 (early access icon), Slide 12 (tech leader visual), Slide 16 (QR code + hero visual).

color_consistency_maintained.justification: All visual designs use the defined color palette: Background #0f0f0f, Primary text #ffffff, Secondary text #9ca3af, Positive/Success #22c55e, Negative/Problem #ef4444, Brand/Highlight #8b5cf6, Accent/CTA #f59e0b. Colors are semantically consistent (green for positive outcomes, red for problems, purple for brand elements).
